 Print Actor Sohail Khan , recently seen on the reality show 'Alliance,' expressed gratitude towards his family. He wrote a short but heartwarming note for his father, veteran screenwriter Salim Khan , and his mother, Salma Khan . Taking to Instagram, he shared a picture of his parents, and in the caption he wrote, “No children in the world can be more fortunate than this (sic)”. Several internet users and celebrity friends poured love into the comments with heart emoticons and warm words. One user wrote, “When parents grow old, treat them good”. Another wrote, “I pray that allah gives salim khan and his full family , health , wealth, long life and happiness in this world and in the next world from allah”. One user mentioned,'MashaAllah Live long Stay together with fit nd healthiness.' A fan wrote, 'The best family and I pray that you all always have all the happiness in the world. So much love between the whole family. ' Sohail Khan recalls father Salim Khan’s health scare 
 Sohail had earlier spoken about his father Salim Khan’s health scare on the reality show. During a conversation with fellow contestant Delbar Arya, he recalled breaking down after doctors told the family that they might lose Salim Khan. In February this year, the veteran screenwriter was hospitalised for a month after suffering a brain haemorrhage. Recalling the difficult time, Sohail also opened up about why he prefers to spend most of his time with his parents. He stated, "My maximum time is spent with my parents because I genuinely believe that time is the most valuable thing you can give somebody. Mere bache hai lekin woh young hai aur unke pass bahut time hai but my parents are old now and that I would like to spend with them”. More about Salim Khan
 On the work front, Salim Khan is one of Hindi cinema’s most celebrated screenwriters and was part of the iconic writing duo Salim-Javed, alongside Javed Akhtar. The duo penned several blockbuster films, including 'Sholay', 'Deewaar', 'Zanjeer', 'Don' and 'Trishul'. Moreover, Salim Khan has four children with his first wife, Salma Khan: Salman Khan , Arbaaz Khan, Sohail Khan and daughter Alvira Khan Agnihotri. He later married actor Helen.
